title: China-to-Mexico Power Tool Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.target_requirement: Mains-powered electric tools and their chargers placed on the Mexican market fall under mandatory NOM electrical safety certification, principally NOM-003-SCFI for the safety of low-voltage electrical products. Certification must be issued by an accredited certification body such as NYCE or ANCE, the NOM mark must appear on the product, and the file must reflect the Mexican grid of 127 or 220 V at 60 Hz. An in-country importer holding a valid RFC tax registration is required to clear and place the product.
target_standards: NOM-003-SCFI (electrical safety of low-voltage products, mandatory)
NMX standards aligned with IEC 62841 for hand-held and transportable motor-operated tools [voluntary supporting standard route]
NOM mark issued through an accredited body such as NYCE or ANCE
In-country importer with a valid RFC (Registro Federal de Contribuyentes)
rows.china_equivalent: China files often use GB/T 3883 series for tool safety, with CCC where applicable and separate charger evidence. These reports should be mapped to NOM-003-SCFI and the Mexican grid of 127 or 220 V at 60 Hz, not treated as automatic NOM certification.
china_standards: China charger safety evidence where applicable
rows.gap: The common gap is treating GB/T 3883 or CCC reports as sufficient for Mexico. A NOM-003-SCFI certificate from an accredited body, the physical NOM mark, grid alignment to 127 or 220 V at 60 Hz instead of China's 220 or 380 V at 50 Hz, and a Mexican importer with a valid RFC must all be in place.

target.en: Mandatory legal obligation: NOM-003-SCFI electrical safety certification with the NOM mark, issued through an accredited body such as NYCE or ANCE, plus an in-country importer holding a valid RFC. NMX standards aligned with IEC 62841 are a voluntary supporting route.
target.zh: 强制法律义务：经 NYCE 或 ANCE 等认可机构核发的 NOM-003-SCFI 电气安全认证及 NOM 标志，并配有持有有效 RFC 的境内进口商。与 IEC 62841 对齐的 NMX 标准为自愿支持路径。
target.zht: 強制法律義務：經 NYCE 或 ANCE 等認可機構核發的 NOM-003-SCFI 電氣安全認證及 NOM 標誌，並配有持有有效 RFC 的境內進口商。與 IEC 62841 對齊的 NMX 標準為自願支持路徑。

cn.en: China domestic evidence commonly uses GB/T 3883 series, CCC where applicable, and charger-specific evidence.
cn.zh: 中国境内证据通常采用 GB/T 3883 系列、适用的 CCC 及充电器专项证据。
cn.zht: 中國境內證據通常採用 GB/T 3883 系列、適用的 CCC 及充電器專項證據。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Mexico-ready until the tool and charger hold NOM-003-SCFI certification with the NOM mark from an accredited body such as NYCE or ANCE, the file reflects 127 or 220 V at 60 Hz, and a Mexican importer with a valid RFC is in place. GB/T 3883 or CCC alone is not NOM certification.

rows.target_requirement: Mexico does not operate a single broad EMC mark equivalent to the EU EMC Directive for all power tools, so EMC is mostly addressed through the applicable NOM and NMX product standards. The distinct mandatory step is radio homologation by the Instituto Federal de Telecomunicaciones for any cordless tool that contains a radio transmitter such as Bluetooth or wireless connectivity, which requires IFT certification before the radio module can be placed on the market.
target_standards: IFT (Instituto Federal de Telecomunicaciones) homologation for radio transmitters
Applicable NOM and NMX product standards addressing electromagnetic behaviour
Ley Federal de Telecomunicaciones y Radiodifusion for radio-equipment authorisation
rows.china_equivalent: China files often use GB/T EMC test reports and SRRC type approval for radio modules. These can support technical review but do not substitute for Mexican IFT homologation of the radio transmitter.
china_standards: GB/T EMC test reports where applicable
China SRRC type approval for radio modules where applicable
rows.gap: The common gap is assuming a China EMC report or SRRC approval covers Mexico. For corded tools, EMC is folded into the applicable NOM and NMX standards; for cordless tools with a radio, a separate IFT homologation of the transmitter is mandatory and is not satisfied by SRRC or GB/T evidence.

target.en: Mandatory legal obligation for radio-containing cordless tools: IFT homologation of the transmitter. EMC behaviour of non-radio tools is addressed within the applicable mandatory NOM and NMX product standards rather than a standalone EMC mark.
target.zh: 含无线电无绳工具的强制法律义务：对发射模块进行 IFT 认证。非无线电工具的电磁兼容在适用的强制 NOM 与 NMX 产品标准内处理，而非独立 EMC 标志。
target.zht: 含無線電無繩工具的強制法律義務：對發射模組進行 IFT 認證。非無線電工具的電磁相容在適用的強制 NOM 與 NMX 產品標準內處理，而非獨立 EMC 標誌。

cn.en: China EMC reports and SRRC approval do not automatically satisfy Mexican IFT homologation.
cn.zh: 中国 EMC 报告和 SRRC 核准不会自动满足墨西哥 IFT 认证。
cn.zht: 中國 EMC 報告和 SRRC 核准不會自動滿足墨西哥 IFT 認證。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Mexico-ready for cordless tools with a radio until the transmitter holds IFT homologation; for non-radio tools, EMC must be addressed within the applicable NOM and NMX product standards rather than presented as a standalone EU-style EMC mark.

rows.requirement: Market Access, Importer, and NOM Mark Placement
rows.target_requirement: Placing a power tool on the Mexican market requires an in-country importer registered with a valid RFC tax identifier and, for regulated products, registration in the importers registry. The certified product must carry the NOM mark and Spanish-language commercial information and labelling, with conformity assessment held through an accredited body such as NYCE or ANCE. PROFECO conducts market surveillance and can verify labelling and certificate validity, while goods typically enter through ports such as Manzanillo or Veracruz.
target_standards: NOM mark on certified product issued via an accredited body such as NYCE or ANCE
In-country importer with a valid RFC (Registro Federal de Contribuyentes)
NOM-050-SCFI commercial information and Spanish-language labelling for products
PROFECO market surveillance and verification
rows.china_equivalent: China exporters often ship under their own factory documentation with Chinese or English labelling and rely on the buyer for local entry. Mexico requires a domestic importer of record with a valid RFC, the NOM mark, and Spanish-language commercial information that is not part of typical China-domestic files.
china_standards: China factory documentation and export labelling practice
rows.gap: The common gap is shipping without a Mexican importer of record. Exporters must secure an importer with a valid RFC, ensure the certified product bears the NOM mark, and provide Spanish-language commercial information and labelling per NOM-050-SCFI; PROFECO can detain or sanction non-conforming goods at retail.

target.en: Mandatory legal obligation: an in-country importer with a valid RFC, the NOM mark on the certified product, and Spanish-language commercial information under NOM-050-SCFI; PROFECO enforces these at market.
target.zh: 强制法律义务：持有有效 RFC 的境内进口商、经认证产品的 NOM 标志，以及 NOM-050-SCFI 下的西班牙语商业信息；PROFECO 在市场端执法。
target.zht: 強制法律義務：持有有效 RFC 的境內進口商、經認證產品的 NOM 標誌，以及 NOM-050-SCFI 下的西班牙語商業資訊；PROFECO 在市場端執法。

cn.en: China factory documentation and export labelling do not satisfy Mexican importer, NOM-mark, and Spanish-labelling duties.
cn.zh: 中国工厂文件和出口标签不满足墨西哥进口商、NOM 标志和西班牙语标签义务。
cn.zht: 中國工廠文件和出口標籤不滿足墨西哥進口商、NOM 標誌和西班牙語標籤義務。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Mexico-ready until an importer with a valid RFC is in place, the certified product carries the NOM mark, and Spanish-language commercial information under NOM-050-SCFI is provided; PROFECO can sanction non-conforming goods at retail.

rows.target_requirement: Mexico does not operate an equivalent of the EU outdoor-noise marking regime, so there is no mandatory guaranteed sound-power label on the product as a market-access condition for power tools. Noise is instead governed by Mexican occupational and environmental noise rules, principally NOM-011-STPS for worker noise exposure in workplaces and general environmental noise provisions, which fall on the user and the workplace rather than as a product label on the tool. Exporters should not present an EU sound-power marking as a Mexican requirement and should not assume an EU noise certificate satisfies Mexican rules.
target_standards: NOM-011-STPS (occupational noise exposure in workplaces)
Mexican environmental noise provisions (general, user and site obligation)
No EU-style mandatory guaranteed sound-power product marking for power tools
rows.china_equivalent: China handles tool noise mainly through GB/T noise test methods and workplace noise-exposure limits rather than a product noise-emission marking. This is broadly comparable in nature to Mexico, where noise sits with occupational and environmental rules and not a product label.
china_standards: GB/T noise test methods where applicable
rows.gap: There is no product-level noise-marking gap to close for Mexico, because Mexico imposes no EU-style guaranteed sound-power label. The honest position is that an EU outdoor-noise certificate is neither required nor sufficient for Mexico, and any noise obligation that applies is an occupational and environmental duty on the user and the workplace, not a market-access label on the exported tool.

target.en: No mandatory EU-style product noise marking for power tools. Mandatory occupational noise rules such as NOM-011-STPS apply to workplaces and users, not as a product label on the exported tool.
target.zh: 电动工具无强制欧盟式产品噪声标识。NOM-011-STPS 等强制职业噪声规则适用于工作场所和使用者，而非作为出口工具上的产品标签。
target.zht: 電動工具無強制歐盟式產品噪聲標識。NOM-011-STPS 等強制職業噪聲規則適用於工作場所和使用者，而非作為出口工具上的產品標籤。

cn.en: China addresses noise through GB/T test methods and workplace exposure limits rather than a product noise-emission marking.
cn.zh: 中国通过 GB/T 测试方法和工作场所暴露限值处理噪声，而非产品噪声排放标识。
cn.zht: 中國透過 GB/T 測試方法和工作場所暴露限值處理噪聲，而非產品噪聲排放標識。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] No EU-style outdoor-noise product marking applies in Mexico; an EU noise certificate is neither required nor sufficient. The only noise obligations are occupational and environmental duties on the user and workplace, such as NOM-011-STPS, not a label on the exported tool.

source.publisher: Secretaria del Trabajo y Prevision Social (STPS)

rows.target_requirement: Mexico does not operate a single mandatory RoHS-style restricted-substances law for electrical and electronic equipment equivalent to the EU RoHS Directive as a market-access condition for power tools. Substance control in Mexico is handled through general environmental, hazardous-materials, and waste rules under SEMARNAT and related Normas Oficiales Mexicanas, plus customer and retailer specifications. Exporters should not assume an EU RoHS declaration is a Mexican legal requirement, but many Mexican buyers contractually require RoHS-aligned material evidence.
target_standards: SEMARNAT environmental and hazardous-materials framework
Mexican NOM environmental and waste provisions where applicable
Buyer and retailer RoHS-aligned material specifications [contractual, not statutory market-access]
rows.china_equivalent: China RoHS and GB/T material evidence can support substance review. For Mexico this is mostly used to satisfy buyer specifications rather than a mandatory market-access substances mark, so it should be framed as commercial rather than statutory.
rows.gap: The honest gap is commercial, not statutory: Mexico imposes no mandatory RoHS-style product mark for market access, so an EU RoHS declaration is neither required nor sufficient. Exporters should still expect Mexican buyers to ask for RoHS-aligned material evidence and should align supplier declarations to those contractual specifications.

target.en: No mandatory RoHS-style product mark for market access in Mexico. Substance control is via general SEMARNAT environmental, hazardous-materials, and waste rules plus contractual buyer specifications.
target.zh: 墨西哥无强制 RoHS 式市场准入产品标志。物质管控通过 SEMARNAT 一般环境、危险品和废弃物规则及合同买方规格。
target.zht: 墨西哥無強制 RoHS 式市場准入產品標誌。物質管控透過 SEMARNAT 一般環境、危險品和廢棄物規則及合同買方規格。

cn.en: China RoHS or GB/T evidence is used commercially and does not constitute a Mexican statutory substances mark.
cn.zh: 中国 RoHS 或 GB/T 证据用于商业用途，不构成墨西哥法定物质标志。
cn.zht: 中國 RoHS 或 GB/T 證據用於商業用途，不構成墨西哥法定物質標誌。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] No mandatory RoHS-style market-access mark applies in Mexico; an EU RoHS declaration is neither required nor sufficient. Treat RoHS-aligned material evidence as a contractual buyer expectation and align supplier declarations accordingly.

source.publisher: Secretaria de Medio Ambiente y Recursos Naturales (SEMARNAT)

rows.requirement: Battery Rules for Cordless Tools in Mexico
rows.target_requirement: Mexico does not have a single dedicated battery regulation equivalent to the EU Battery Regulation as a product market-access condition. For cordless power tools, the lithium battery pack is mainly addressed through the applicable NOM electrical safety scope, transport-of-dangerous-goods rules for shipping, and any IFT homologation if the tool carries a radio. There is no EU-style battery passport, removability mandate, or battery CE-equivalent mark required for market access in Mexico, although Spanish-language safety labelling and importer obligations still apply.
target_standards: Applicable NOM electrical safety scope covering the cordless tool and its charger
Dangerous-goods transport rules for lithium batteries (shipping)
IFT homologation where the cordless tool carries a radio transmitter
Spanish-language safety labelling under NOM-050-SCFI
rows.china_equivalent: China tool files often treat the battery pack as an accessory tested with the tool under GB/T 3883 or with separate lithium-battery transport and safety evidence. For Mexico this maps onto NOM safety scope and transport rules rather than a dedicated battery market-access regime.
china_standards: China lithium battery safety and transport evidence where applicable
rows.gap: The honest position is that Mexico has no EU-style battery passport, removability mandate, or standalone battery conformity mark as a market-access condition, so those EU duties should not be presented as Mexican requirements. The real Mexican obligations are NOM electrical safety coverage of the cordless system, dangerous-goods transport compliance, IFT homologation if a radio is present, and Spanish-language labelling under the importer.

target.en: No EU-style standalone battery regulation for market access in Mexico. Mandatory duties for cordless tools are NOM electrical safety scope, dangerous-goods transport compliance, IFT homologation if a radio is present, and Spanish-language labelling under the importer.
target.zh: 墨西哥无欧盟式独立电池市场准入法规。无绳工具的强制义务为 NOM 电气安全范围、危险品运输合规、含无线电时的 IFT 认证，以及由进口商负责的西班牙语标签。
target.zht: 墨西哥無歐盟式獨立電池市場准入法規。無繩工具的強制義務為 NOM 電氣安全範圍、危險品運輸合規、含無線電時的 IFT 認證，以及由進口商負責的西班牙語標籤。

cn.en: China tool and battery evidence is used as accessory and transport evidence and does not constitute a Mexican standalone battery mark.
cn.zh: 中国工具和电池证据用作附件及运输证据，不构成墨西哥独立电池标志。
cn.zht: 中國工具和電池證據用作附件及運輸證據，不構成墨西哥獨立電池標誌。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] No EU-style battery passport, removability mandate, or standalone battery mark applies in Mexico for cordless tools; the real duties are NOM electrical safety scope, dangerous-goods transport, IFT homologation if a radio is present, and Spanish-language labelling under the importer.
